info.name: Get all companies with either orders or trades

params.name: has409aValuations
params.description: Filter to only companies with 409a valuations

params.name: coisAvailable
params.description: Filter to only companies for which Caplight tracks Certificate of Incorporation (COI) filings

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of companies with at least one order or trade. Optional filters: `has409aValuations` and `coisAvailable`.
